items.title: Milford Dolliole Interview, 1965-05-22
items.q: I played music with him with Georgie Parker Band at Happyland and out the lake.

ctx.x: I played music with him with Georgie Parker Band at Happyland and out the lake. We played there about four years.
When was that? That wouldn't be awfully long ago I guess. With Georgie Parker?
Well, that was in the late 40's.
